Subject: Gartner Quadrant vignette request - short data & quote for Acme Health

Hi Tom,

Quick email — hope you’re well. Gartner (Priya Desai) reached out asking whether Acme Health would be willing to provide a very short customer vignette and a one-sentence quote for an upcoming quadrant insight. This is a 15–20 minute ask (they want product impact + a line on why you chose Redwood).

What they’d like from us/you:
- A one-paragraph vignette (3–4 sentences) describing the outcome and where Redwood is used.
- 1–2 anonymized metrics (e.g., inference latency improvement, cost per 1M tokens, time-to-deploy) — we can redact exact dollar figures if preferred.
- A one-line quote (for the report).

Dates: Gartner is looking to finalize copy by next Friday (Feb 18). If you’re open, could you share availability for a 15-min call this week or early next? If easier, Laura has drafted a proposed vignette we can send for quick approval.

We won’t share any sensitive PHI — we’ll work with you on redaction. If you prefer to sign off on a short final PDF, we’ll route that back to you.

Thanks,
Ben

--
Ben Carter

Ben,

Thanks for the heads up — happy to help. We can do a quick 15-min sync. My availability this week: Wed 2/10 10:00–11:00am PT or Thu 2/11 2:00–3:00pm PT. If those don’t work, early next week is also possible.

A couple of quick asks from our side:
- Please keep any customer metrics high-level (percentage improvements are fine; please avoid raw PHI or customer identifiers).
- Send the draft vignette for our legal/comms to glance at before final share.

If Laura already has something, please send it over and I’ll flag edits inline.

Tom

Acme Health

Tom — attaching a very short draft vignette for quick review (attachment: acme_vignette_draft.docx). I kept it to a single paragraph + a one-line quote so legal/comms can approve quickly. Draft below as plain text in case the attachment is blocked: 

"Acme Health reduced inference latency by ~40% after migrating critical routing models to Redwood Inference. The unified serving runtime and smart routing helped the team keep latency predictable under peak traffic while lowering GPU spend through batching and caching. Redwood’s deployment abstraction let us roll out the new model version without disrupting production."

Proposed quote: "Redwood gave us predictable inference performance with a clear path to lower per-token cost — it accelerated our rollout and reduced operational uncertainty." — Tom Rivers, Director, Product Strategy, Acme Health

Notes:
- I used a percentage for latency improvement; if you prefer a different metric (e.g., median P99) we can swap.
- If you want to redact the company name for the public vignette, we can submit an anonymized wording.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Tell me which metric to change/redact.
2) Confirm a 15-min slot from the times Ben suggested and I’ll set the calendar invite.

Attachment: acme_vignette_draft.docx

Laura Bennett
Customer Advocacy Lead, Redwood Inference
